title: Reference images come to Play
summary:
Reference-image editing got easier, nine community apps joined the directory, and caching and Flower-tier workflows got attention behind the scenes.

Play now accepts up to four reference-image URLs for models that support image input, with thumbnails and controls to remove them. It also shows API error messages instead of generic status text. An updated gptimage-large API version supports reference-image edit requests; the generator's nologo option was removed.

The community listings added aquarium care, vocabulary and study tools; Indonesian and lightweight chat apps; a Persian image generator; and creative tools for prompts, logos, business names, and coloring books. These PRs add listings, not changes to the apps themselves.

The beta banner no longer overlaps the navigation, and the mobile footer gives its social icons more room. Text and image generation cards in the docs now retry after a 429 response, using the API's suggested wait when available.

highlights.title: Reference images in Play
highlights.text: Add up to four image URLs as references when generating with models that support image input. Preview and remove them before you generate. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).
